item.title: Secure WordPress Hardening & Code Integration
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Quick Turnaround: WordPress Hardening & Code Integration for Simple 1-Page Club Website
Project Description:
We are looking for a meticulous, security-conscious WordPress developer to finalize a website project. This is a straightforward, small-budget task with a quick turnaround because we have already prepared the technical assets. The active malware from a previous developer has been fully removed, and the site is completely clean. Our primary goal now is absolute prevention. We need a professional who can safely integrate our provided updates without reintroducing vulnerabilities, ensuring that the system is fully hardened against future exploits.
What we provide:
• The exact PHP code snippets required for the updates. • A clear written explanation of how to apply them. • A comprehensive Theme Guide. • 3 clear JPEG screenshots detailing the final layout adjustments. Your job is to safely implement this provided material, ensure the code is fully sanitized, and guarantee that the website functions perfectly with or without the new code enabled (robust fallback logic).
Scope of Work:
1. Security Hardening & Prevention: Review the environment to implement strict security guardrails. Ensure no backdoors exist, file permissions are secure, and unauthorized file execution is blocked so malware cannot be reintroduced. 2. Safe Code Integration: Apply the provided PHP code snippets to functions.php / shortcodes.php to register a new text/pricing field inside our "Club Content" admin panel (alongside existing Stripe/Printify fields). 3. Fallback & Graceful Degradation: Build defensive checks so that the site, admin panel, and the [gw_membership_dialog] shortcode function flawlessly, whether this new code is actively running or temporarily disabled. 4. Final Layout Adjustments: Implement the straightforward layout and content changes explicitly outlined across our 3 attached JPEG screenshots. 5. Secure Handover Documentation: Provide a short, concise guide detailing how we can handle routine updates safely moving forward without risking code regression or security slips.
Requirements: • Proven experience in WordPress Security Hardening and secure coding (input sanitization, data validation). • Strong PHP skills, specifically with WordPress hooks, shortcodes, and defensive coding (preventing site crashes if a function is missing). • High attention to detail—the ability to strictly follow provided technical instructions. • Fast availability to complete this small task efficiently. All files, pre-written code snippets, and visual guides are ready to go. Please bid with your fastest turnaround time and your realistic fixed price for a streamlined task of this size.

item.title: Professional bstoddard.com Website Redesign

I want a complete visual refresh—especially of the homepage—so the brand projects an edgy yet professional personality while still feeling reliable.

If you plan to tackle only design or both design and development, just let me know your preferred workflow. Clean code, accessibility considerations, and clear documentation are must-haves for acceptance.

item.title: WordPress Age Gate & Checkout Tweaks
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’m looking to tidy up a few key user-experience points on my WooCommerce site.
First, every new visitor must pass a 21+ age gate that appears as a pop-up when the site loads. If someone clicks “I’m under 21,” they should be taken straight to a simple “You must be 21 or older” page and barred from browsing further.
Second, I’d like the major credit-card logos displayed consistently in the footer, on every product page, and again on the checkout screen so shoppers instantly know their payment options.
Finally, before any payment is processed I want an Order Review page inserted—essentially a final summary step that lets customers double-check items, quantities, totals, and shipping details before they commit.
Deliverables • Age-verification pop-up with under-21 redirect • “You must be 21 or older” landing page • Credit-card icon placement in footer, product pages, and checkout • Order Review step added just prior to payment submission
The site runs on the latest WordPress + WooCommerce stack, so you’ll need solid PHP, JS, and CSS skills to implement and style these features cleanly without breaking existing functionality. Let me know your timeline and any plugin or custom-code approach you prefer so we can get started right away.

item.title: Accelerate Online Store Speed
item.description:
30-250 AUD | My online store feels sluggish from the moment a visitor lands, and I want every page to snap open instantly. The primary goal is simple: make the entire site load faster so shoppers stay engaged and move smoothly from browsing to checkout.
Here’s what I need:
• A quick but thorough performance audit using Lighthouse, GTmetrix, or similar tools to identify render-blocking scripts, oversized images, and any bottlenecks in the theme or plugins. • Hands-on optimisation—minifying CSS/JS, compressing images, enabling browser and server-side caching, refining database queries, and configuring a CDN if it will help. • Concrete before-and-after metrics: I’m aiming for a Largest Contentful Paint under 2 seconds and Google PageSpeed scores in the green for both mobile and desktop.
Please be comfortable working on live e-commerce sites where downtime must be kept to an absolute minimum. Share a brief outline of your approach and examples of stores you have already sped up, and we can get started right away.
removing all the not required processes, old WP installations, updating plugins, removing or disabling unnecessary plugins, etc. Could be the speed problem

I have no fixed deadline, so you can propose a realistic schedule and milestone breakdown that fits the scope. It don´t need a high resoultion rendering, cause its on a website, live.

item.title: Harrow Now Local Guide Content Development
item.description:

item.title: WordPress Paid Course Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m launching a site that sells digital products—think guides, templates, and mini-courses—through one-time purchases. After checkout, each buyer needs a secure account area where they can immediately download only the files they’ve paid for and return later to retrieve them again.
Here’s the flow I want: 1. Visitor selects a file or bundle, adds it to cart, and pays (credit card, PayPal, or Stripe—whichever is quickest for you to configure). 2. Upon successful payment, WordPress automatically creates their account, logs them in, and unlocks the corresponding download page. 3. Inside “My Account,” they see a clean list of their purchases with download buttons, file size, and a limited number of download attempts to discourage sharing. 4. I receive order notifications and can add or revoke access from the dashboard.
Preferred stack is WooCommerce or Easy Digital Downloads paired with a lightweight membership plugin if necessary; I’m open to your suggestion as long as it stays maintainable and doesn’t bloat the site. Design can start from a modern, responsive theme—no need for a pixel-perfect custom build—just ensure branding colors and a clear call-to-action are in place.
Deliverables • WordPress installation and theme setup on my hosting • Payment gateway integration and test transaction proof • Product upload example with protected download link • Customer “My Account” area fully functional • Brief video or written guide showing how I add future products and view orders
I’ll handle copy and imagery; you focus on structure, security, and a friction-free checkout. Let me know your preferred plugin combo and estimated timeline when you bid.

item.title: Build Scalable Christian Ministry Website Kenya
item.description: 200-350 USD | WordPress Website Developer — A Christian Ministry, Kenya Project: Modern, affordable and scalable Christian music ministry website Budget: $200–$350 fixed price for initial launch We are seeking an experienced WordPress developer to create a professional, fast-loading and easy-to-manage website for Maiden Ministry, a Christian gospel music ministry based in Kenya. We want a visually attractive website that promotes our music, reaches audiences internationally, supports donations and can eventually sell merchandise. Initial website features 1. Modern homepage with ministry introduction, photographs and featured music. 2. About Us page presenting our mission and team. 3. Music gallery with YouTube video embedding. Administrators must be able to add new songs simply by pasting YouTube links. 4. Events section with dates, venues, descriptions and announcements. 5. Donation page supporting M-PESA and international card payments through a reputable provider such as Paystack, subject to account approval. 6. Contact page with WhatsApp and social media integration. 7. Basic SEO, Google Search Console, mobile optimization, SSL and backups. Scalability requirements • Use self-hosted WordPress and a lightweight theme. • Structure the website so WooCommerce can be added later for merchandise sales. • Prefer free, well-maintained plugins. • Avoid Elementor Pro or other recurring paid dependencies unless specifically approved. • Do not build a custom backend or require paid ongoing developer maintenance. • Use secure hosted payment processing. No storage of payment card information on our server. Ownership and handover The ministry must retain full ownership and administrative access to the domain, hosting, WordPress and payment accounts. Provide a complete website backup, documentation, and a recorded training session covering content updates, YouTube videos, events, donations and routine maintenance. Include post-launch bug fixes. Please provide: • Fixed price and delivery timeframe. • Two or three similar websites you developed. • Number of days to support post-launch bug fixes. • Proposed theme, plugins and hosting provider. • Complete list of recurring costs. • Confirmation that the website can be managed without coding. • Confirmation that the design is mobile-friendly and expandable. We are looking for excellent value, long-term maintainability and a modern professional appearance, not an unnecessarily complex website.

item.title: Eagle Fintech Investor Platform Prototype
item.description: 250-750 USD | Hiring: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX), Visual Product Walkthrough | Contract Domura Technologies Group is building Eagle, patent-pending infrastructure for the American home purchase. Eagle carries a borrower through four stages, Diagnose → Resolve → Monitor → Transact. It starts at the point of mortgage denial and runs all the way to closing. Five licensed subsidiaries cover mortgage, real estate, title, insurance placement, and credit monitoring. This is a design-only project. No coding and no working software. We need a visual walkthrough that shows investors exactly how Eagle looks and how a borrower moves through it, screen by screen. Deliverables • Five high-fidelity screens: onboarding, a denial-diagnosis dashboard, a credit file correction and resolution plan, a progress-monitoring view, and a closing/transaction flow • A non-functional click-through prototype in Figma (linked screens that simulate the experience) • A 2–3 minute walkthrough video of the borrower journey, as a screen-recorded click-through with smooth transitions • Desktop and mobile layouts • Investor-ready exports (PDF, PNG, MP4) Technical expectations • Figma expert: Auto Layout, components and variants, interactive prototyping, transitions • Experience designing data-dense dashboards and multi-step financial workflows • Ability to show product states clearly (denied, in progress, approved, closing) • Experience with screen recording and basic motion (Figma, ProtoPie, After Effects, or similar) • Clean, trustworthy visual design suited to regulated consumer financial data Who we want • 5+ years in product design, with fintech, lending, PropTech, or SaaS work • Ability to make a complex system simple and accurate on screen • 100% original, human-made design. No AI-generated visuals. Terms • NDA and full IP assignment to Domura Technologies Group, Inc., signed before you receive product materials • Short-term contract, with a strong path to ongoing work post-funding To apply, send: Live Figma links to 2–3 past product projects A sample walkthrough video or prototype you created, if you have one Availability, timeline, and your rate Only candidates who send Figma links will be reviewed.
